time/day#

Immutable civil time within one nominal day.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let noon = TimeOfDay(
    hour: 12,
    minute: 0,
    second: 0,
    nanosecond: 0,
);
noon.order(TimeOfDay(
    hour: 12,
    minute: 0,
    second: 0,
    nanosecond: 1,
)); // Order.less

Description#

Immutable civil time within one nominal day.

TimeOfDay carries no date, offset or time zone. Seconds are 0..59: leap seconds are timeline events and are deliberately not encoded as civil field values. Nanoseconds are integral and never rounded.
